title: The 10 Best Chalk Lines
subtitle: Chalk reels and chalk boxes for snapping layout lines on framing, flooring, roofing and drywall, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A chalk line snaps a long, straight mark that a tape and pencil can't. We ranked 10 best-sellers from IRWIN, Tajima, OX, Klein Tools, Milwaukee, Lufkin and Keson on rating, review volume and features (rewind gear ratio, line length, chalk in the box and a metal case). Prices run from $9.49 to $48.64.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

products.name: Tajima Chalk Line, ChalkRite II Extra Bold, 1.0 mm Braided Line, Die-Cast Aluminum Case (CR201C-CP)

products.name: OX Chalk Line Box & Marking Chalk Reel Kit - 6:1 Gear, 100ft String, Blue

products.verdict: OX's 6:1 reel with a 100 ft, 8-strand line, sold with a 4 oz bottle of blue chalk. It's the only pick here that pairs a 6:1 gear with chalk in the box.

Reviews are shared with the OX reel-only listing

products.name: OX 100ft Thick Chalk Line Tool - Heavy Duty 6:1 Gear Chalk Reel, OX-P027731

pros: 3:1 gear rewinds three times faster than a direct-drive reel
cons: Line and case material not listed

products.verdict: A long-running octagonal reel with a 1.5 mm bold cord, a steel crank and a self-sealing refill grommet. The flat sides sit square in corners.

products.name: IRWIN Tools STRAIT-LINE Chalk Line, Classic Reel, Blue, 100ft (IWHT48441BC)

products.verdict: IRWIN's basic 100 ft reel and the best seller on this page by monthly sales. IRWIN says one pull of chalk gives 5 to 6 snaps, and the center line doubles as a plumb bob.

Nested hook dock cuts down on snags
cons: Bullets say aluminum housing, the spec table says plastic

products.name: Crescent Lufkin 50' Compact Chalk Reel with Blue Chalk, CL50

products.verdict: Two Milwaukee bold-line reels for about $12.50 each, handy for a crew or for keeping two chalk colors loaded. The listing has almost no specs.

avoid.name: Edward Tools Chalk Line Tool Set with Reel, Powder, Line Level - 3 Piece Chalk Line Set
avoid.verdict: A cheap set whose feature bullets repeat IRWIN's STRAIT-LINE listing nearly word for word, so the listing doesn't tell you what this reel does. It also states a 1:1 gear, the slowest rewind there is.
reasons: Its bullets on strikes per pull, the nested hook dock, the wide refill door and the plumb-bob center line match the IRWIN Classic listing almost exactly, so they describe IRWIN's reel, not this one.
The listing states a 1:1 gear ratio: one turn of the crank winds one turn of line. The IRWIN Compact on this page is 3:1 and the OX reels are 6:1.
The IRWIN Classic costs about $1 more and comes from the brand that wrote that description.

buyers_guide.q: How long a chalk line do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 100 ft covers framing, roofing and most floors. A 30 to 50 ft compact reel is easier to carry for drywall, tile and cabinet layout. 150 ft only pays off on slabs and big decks.

buyers_guide.q: What does the gear ratio mean?
buyers_guide.a: It's how many times the spool turns for each turn of the crank. A 6:1 reel rewinds 100 ft in a few cranks; a reel with no gearing (1:1) takes many more. If you snap lines all day, a 4:1 to 6:1 gear saves real time.

buyers_guide.q: Which chalk color should I use?
buyers_guide.a: Blue is the standard for indoor work because it brushes and washes off. Red and other bold colors are more permanent and are meant for outdoor work where the line has to survive weather. Don't use red on finished surfaces.
A thin line (around 0.5 mm) leaves a precise mark for finish work and tile. A bold line (1 mm and up) carries more chalk and shows up on rough lumber, sheathing and concrete.

buyers_guide.q: Does a chalk line work as a plumb bob?
buyers_guide.a: Many do. Several reels here, including the IRWIN Classic, are shaped so the line hangs straight from the center of the case. A dedicated plumb bob is still more precise for tall drops.
